result.travessiaTitle: You have seen it. But seeing is not dissolving.
result.travessiaBody: There is a 21-day path to descend to what is beneath, to the origin, to what it is doing to your marriage, and to how to dissolve it in silence.
result.travessiaStep2Body: You go to the origin. Not in affirmations, in specific movements.
result.travessiaStep3Body: You dissolve the pattern. And he begins to look for you.
result.travessiaRhythm: Seven sessions. 21 days. Each opens three days after the one before. No shortcuts.
result.offerIncludes: 5 sessions tailored to your knot, 5 practices, lifetime access.

result.secondaryBody: {no} also showed up in your answers. It is not your main knot, it is a shadow of the main one. When the dominant one dissolves, this one tends to ease on its own.
result.or: Or come back when you're ready. The diagnostic stays here, yours to redo whenever you need.
